comment: Take notes doing class and study them before the tests. He loves to include tons of math problems in the test, memorize all of the math formulas and you'll be fine.
Extremely boring lectures but if you pay attention and take notes you will do well on the tests. Also usually massive curves on exams. Very little homework.

Beyond generous grading curve (a 54 was a C on one exam). His lectures are boring but he does a good job of explaining things, and if you put in average effort in his class, you'll cruise in his class. Go to office hours for homework, he helps you on each problem and it's a decent size of your grade. Plus, exams somewhat reflect homework
Tests are a little challenging, but as long as you study for them they're not that bad. Three tests make up 80% of the grade. Takes off attendance points for being on your phone/computer in class.

Although Prof. Wilson is a nice guy, his lectures are quite boring and it is hard to remain engaged. His tests are also difficult, but if you use your notes you will be fine. I would personally not recommend him with better macro options available.
Dr. Wilson is a beast. Love the dude and his class is enjoyable. Lots of lectures, but he makes them interesting.

I liked him as a professor. He is good at explaining concepts so that they make sense. Lectures are generally easy to follow and organised. He does not give a lot of homework. He only gave 4 assignments total. Total grade is mainly comprised of exam grades. You need to study for tests but they're reasonable in difficulty.

This man honestly has to be one of the most boring teachers ever. Shows up to class everyday in sweatpants and then proceeds to lecture you for one hour straight with no interaction or real world examples. His only good quality is he grades everything (even hw) with a heavy curve so an A is super easy, . Try to take anyone else before you can
